tool_args.rationale: The five observations establish a smooth increasing, concave response in u_now, but do not distinguish a saturating/Haldane-like law from a power-law or other branch. The targeted open_branch_discriminating_probe is the least-cost relevant measurement available; the other pilot covariates are effectively fixed, so a fitted model would be weakly identified.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a saturating-response model from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed monotone-concave response over a single fixed horizon and nearly fixed s_grad can fit multiple plausible mechanisms; extrapolating now risks failing fresh confirmation.
A broad batch is more costly than the targeted open-branch probe for resolving the current response-shape ambiguity.
It is unrelated to the observed ambiguity and should not be purchased.
